limitations: Footprint extrusions represent measured plan perimeter and roof height, not facade, roof shape or photorealistic models.
NTA2020 boundaries are statistical areas, not legal neighborhood boundaries.
Height, address, construction year and ground elevation remain null when unavailable; zero roof and ground source values are treated as unknown.
Overview and neighborhood details contain every matched non-placeholder source footprint; neighborhood details are available separately for focused loading.
241 footprint parts outside Manhattan NTA polygons were excluded; 6 permit placeholders were excluded.
Basemap observations are not catastrophe hazard, first-floor elevation or underwriting evidence.

Catch basins are mapped surface inlet positions with unknown depth and connectivity. Historic Open Sewer Atlas NYC interceptors and force mains are unofficial, incomplete, illustrative only and not for planning. Depths are unknown; no drain connections are inferred.

Terrain uses USGS 3DEP one-metre bare-earth sources sampled at about 10m in neighborhood detail and 50m in the overview. Elevations are NAVD88 metres; source NoData and cells outside Manhattan remain unknown. Historical source tiles can differ at project boundaries; this is not an engineering survey.
